card.summary: S.J. Res. 91 is a joint resolution that uses the Congressional Review Act to officially disapprove and cancel a Bureau of Land Management rule from December 9, 2024. That rule established a record of decision for the Coastal Plain Oil and Gas Leasing Program in the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge, which had set aside about 1.2 million acres as unavailable for leasing while keeping the statutory minimum of 400,000 acres available.
